root: Compiled CSharp runtime and Native runtime quote every argv entry. WSL interprets quoted --exec as command text; CSharp Tooling uses .NET minimal argument quoting.
decision: Copy simple nonempty argv entries without added quotes; preserve existing quote/backslash escaping for empty, whitespace or quote-containing entries. Unicode whitespace list matches Char.IsWhiteSpace BMP values. Preserve independent raw program pointer and owned per-argument allocations.
slgDecision: Port identical Unicode quote-admission scan and owned plain-copy branch; retain existing quoted encoding and program-path ownership. CSharp helper has emitter-specific #0 attribute; SLG omits it consistently.
wslObservation: Minimal quoting changes actual WSL true result127 to0, but Windows owned-job descendant check still fails; both raw WSL records remain failed. No WSL support or shutdown qualification claimed.
